references.text: The same construction with four gold rings is used for the Ark of the Covenant, showing a parallel in the design of the sanctuary furniture.
Fulfillment of the instruction to make four gold rings for the table of showbread, carried out by Bezalel.
Gold rings are also used on the altar of incense to carry it, following the same principle for transporting holy objects.
The continuation explains the placement of the rings near the edge as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
Four gold rings cast for the Ark of the Covenant at its four feet, following the same pattern for the sanctuary furniture.
